author: Techno Tim
description:
I wanted to see how good local self-hosted AI has actually gotten, so I built a mini AI cluster on my desk and tested it with a real coding workflow.

Can a local AI coding agent actually build and improve a real app? And does adding a second machine make the workflow better, or just add more complexity?

This is a practical test of the ASUS Ascent GX10, vLLM, OpenCode, power draw, Open Weight Models, and what local AI feels like to actually use.

Thank you to ASUS for sending these 2 GX10s to test.
ASUS Ascent GX10: https://amzn.to/4eTMpaD (Amazon affiliate link)
